name: Cable Incline Bench Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline centered between two low pulleys.
Lie back with feet flat and hold a handle beside each side of your upper chest.
Press the handles up and slightly together above your upper chest until your arms straighten.
Lower both handles under control until your elbows return beside your torso.
tips: Keep your shoulders resting against the pad.
Keep your forearms roughly vertical at the bottom and avoid arching your lower back off the bench.
